svg.title: Default univariate animal-model path (Julia engine)
svg.desc: Flowchart of the engine-side univariate animal model: pedigree and phenotype become a validated spec, AI-REML returns variance components, heritability, and breeding values. Genomic and multivariate paths are not shown.
